name: USGS Earthquakes live seismic clustered-point overlay

scenarios.prompt: Show recent earthquakes around Tokyo, Japan.
Show recent earthquakes within 100 kilometers of latitude 0, longitude -140.

fixes.summary: Stamp spatial_scope_satisfied and temporal_scope_satisfied on vector provider results (resolved-location and non-explicit-range requests) so the render completion data_checks pass, mirroring the raster spatial-scope contract.

The bbox spatial-scope intersection check only handled GeoJSON geometry features; USGS/Open-Meteo/CO-OPS/Overpass return normalized latitude/longitude features. Added _feature_spatial_geometry() to accept both shapes.
Mark coverage.query_complete on valid_empty results so the honest no-results boundary counts as data-valid in the completion assessment.
Treat an undated historical+recent aggregation route as current, matching the existing granularity-based recent_scope_normalized_to_current normalization.

remaining_limitation: Visibility mutation (hide/show) and remove/re-add lifecycle actions rely on the shared overlay-controls mechanism validated in T3-02/T3-06; the earthquakes-specific render, valid-empty, attribution, and acknowledgement boundaries are the new evidence recorded here.
